title: PDF signer: sign a PDF online
description: Sign a PDF without a printer or scanner: draw your signature with a finger or mouse, type your name or upload a photo of your signature, then place it and the date where needed. Nothing is uploaded.

ui.drawHere: Sign here with your finger or mouse
ui.name: Full name
ui.uploadHint: Sign on a sheet of white paper and take a photo in good light. The background becomes transparent and the extra margins are cropped.
ui.emptySig: The signature is empty — draw or type something.
ui.badImage: Couldn't read the image. Try JPG or PNG.
ui.dragHint: Drag the signature into place. The blue dot in the corner resizes it, the cross removes it.
ui.textLabel: Text such as your printed name or initials
